interpretations: Count matched transaction records by their trader’s `tradekind`, including a separate group for missing types. Return groups whose record count exceeds the arithmetic mean of the group counts, with each group’s count, share of all matched records, and difference from that mean. Return no rows if the mean is missing.

Count distinct traders who have at least one matched transaction record by `tradekind`, including a separate group for missing types. Return groups whose trader count exceeds the arithmetic mean of the group counts, with each group’s count, share of all matched traders, and difference from that mean. Return no rows if the mean is missing.
queries:
WITH group_counts AS (
    SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM transactionrecord AS tr
    JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
    GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
group_stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(record_count) AS mean_count,
           SUM(record_count) AS total_count
    FROM group_counts
)
SELECT g.tradekind,
       g.record_count,
       1.0 * g.record_count / s.total_count AS record_share,
       g.record_count - s.mean_count AS difference_from_mean
FROM group_counts AS g
CROSS JOIN group_stats AS s
WHERE s.mean_count IS NOT NULL
  AND g.record_count > s.mean_count

WITH matched_traders AS (
    SELECT t.tradereg, t.tradekind
    FROM trader AS t
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM transactionrecord AS tr
        WHERE tr.trdref = t.tradereg
    )
),
group_counts AS (
    SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS trader_count
    FROM matched_traders
    GROUP BY tradekind
),
group_stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(trader_count) AS mean_count,
           SUM(trader_count) AS total_traders
    FROM group_counts
)
SELECT g.tradekind,
       g.trader_count,
       CAST(g.trader_count AS REAL) / s.total_traders AS trader_share,
       g.trader_count - s.mean_count AS difference_from_mean
FROM group_counts AS g
CROSS JOIN group_stats AS s
WHERE s.mean_count IS NOT NULL
  AND g.trader_count > s.mean_count;
